ablations.name: Audit gate
ablations.interpretation: Without audit-grounded support edges, unsupported claim leakage rises while the fixture still completes.

ablations.name: Strict source policy
ablations.interpretation: Relaxing trusted-only enforcement keeps the bundle flowing but admits a source the strict policy would block.

ablations.name: Evidence-first synthesis
ablations.interpretation: Removing evidence-first grounding erodes provenance and support quality immediately in the emitted bundle.

ablations.name: Rerank / edge selection
ablations.interpretation: Disabling the rerank-like edge selection leaves a critical claim with only context-only evidence.

ablations.name: Provider auto-routing
ablations.interpretation: Auto-routing can be inspected deterministically, but this local follow-up run does not include live quality or billing comparisons.

ablations.name: V2 runtime vs legacy
ablations.interpretation: No like-for-like legacy runtime fixture remains that matches the current deterministic job contracts and bundle outputs.
